lead.headline: Flowers needs 36.8 — and Wilson's quarterback is in tests
lead.deck: All nine starters are final at 136.94. Green Bay's bye leaves the D/ST empty for Week 11; the Bears are the fix when the week rolls.
lead.body: The bad news first. Garrett Wilson drew 14 targets on Sunday, but his quarterback, Geno Smith, is having tests on an ankle and starts at the Chargers only if healthy; Cade Klubnik threw for 137 yards in relief. Omar Cooper Jr. may have a high-ankle sprain, which would push more of the Jets' targets Wilson's way. Denzel Boston finished on a sore toe and Cleveland, like Green Bay, are off next week; Jaylen Waddle's concussion has had no update since 10 November. The game itself is all but done: Nicky Jam need 36.8 from Zay Flowers tonight, catching from Jacoby Brissett in his first Baltimore start. When the week rolls, swap the Packers D/ST for the Bears, who host New Orleans.
